item.title: backlog check --all audits every item for readiness gates in one pass
item.intent: Users must be able to run 'backlog check --all' and see a table of every non-done item with its readiness gate status and failure reasons, so they can fix the whole backlog in one pass instead of checking item by item.
item.description: backlog check validates one item at a time. Users with large backlogs have no way to audit all items at once — they must loop manually. A --all flag on backlog check should iterate every non-done item, run the same gate checks, and print a summary table: item ID, PASS/FAIL, and which gates failed. This directly complements BUG-100: once auto warns about skipped items, users need a fast way to find and fix all broken items without running check N times.
